corner_definition: capture within 280 units of two adjacent walls (>=2 of 4 wall distances <= 280; opposite-wall co-occurrence is geometrically impossible at 280 in a 2048x1536 arena)
single_wall_definition: capture within 280 units of at least one wall (min wall distance <= 280)
collection_item_classification: data-driven from purchase_offer effects/tags: game `pickup` tag, `pickup_range` effect, or `instant_gold_attracting` effect. `stat_range` (weapon attack range) is excluded.
